2.2IntroductionMicrosoftCopilot
03 · Copilot foundations

What is Copilot — model, grounding & surfaces

Five building blocks sit behind every answer: your everyday apps take your ask, the Copilot orchestrator grounds it in your work through Work IQ and in current facts through web grounding, and a large language model reasons and writes the answer.

Microsoft CopilotHow an answer is made
1Ask2Ground3Ground4Prompt5Draft6Reply
Where it livesThe orchestratorThe engineGroundingThe answerSelect a box to see what it does
1
Your everyday appsWhere it lives

You ask Copilot where you already work: copilot.cloud.microsoft, the Copilot app, Teams and Outlook — and, with Microsoft Copilot (Premium), inside Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

ExampleIn the Copilot app: “Ringkas notulen rapat bidang ini dan daftar tindak lanjut yang masih terbuka.”

2
Copilot orchestratorThe coordinator

Coordinates the language model, your context and the tools. It reads your prompt, gets grounding from Work IQ and the web, sends a grounded prompt to the model, and checks the response before you see it.

ExampleIt finds the notulen rapat bidang you can open, adds it to your prompt, and sends both to the model.

3
A large language modelThe engine

Reads the grounded prompt and writes the draft. Copilot can use more than one model — leave it on Auto and Copilot picks the model for the task (see Choosing your model in Chat). Your prompts and work data are not used to train the foundation models.

ExampleIt reads the notulen, then drafts the summary and the list of tindak lanjut.

4
Work IQGrounding in your work
Premium

Grounds the answer in your work — email, chats, meetings and files in OneDrive and SharePoint — through Microsoft Graph. It only reads content you already have permission to open. With Copilot Chat (Basic), you bring work content in by attaching files (see Bringing your files into Chat).

Example“Apa yang disepakati di rapat bidang minggu lalu?” — Copilot finds the meeting recap and the follow-up email.

5
Web groundingGrounding in the web
BasicPremium

When web search is on, Copilot sends a short search query to Bing — not your whole prompt or your files — and uses the results for current facts, with citations.

Example“Rangkum berita publik terbaru tentang adopsi QRIS di Indonesia.”

6
An answer you can useThe answer

The answer comes back where you work, with citations you can open to check the source. You stay in charge: review it, edit it, then use it.

ExampleA five-bullet summary, with links to the pages of the notulen it used.

In a nutshell

Microsoft Copilot = in-app experience + Copilot orchestrator + LLM + Work IQ + web grounding. Your prompt goes in, the orchestrator grounds it in your data and the web, the model writes the draft, and the answer comes back where you work — inside Bank Mandiri’s Microsoft 365 security boundary.

Source Microsoft Copilot overview — Microsoft Learn · Overview of the Copilot orchestrator — Microsoft Learn · How does Microsoft Copilot work? — Microsoft Learn

3.3Copilot foundationsMicrosoftCopilot
03 · Copilot foundations

Secure by design — Enterprise Data Protection

BasicPremium

Copilot does not bypass Bank Mandiri’s security — it rides on top of it. Here is what protects you, and where your prompt goes.

What EDP gives you
  • Your data is not used to train models. Prompts, responses and the data used for grounding never train the foundation models.
  • It inherits your protections. Identity, security, compliance and privacy policies — including Microsoft Purview and sensitivity labels.
  • It respects permissions. Copilot only surfaces content you can already open — it never widens your reach.
  • Web queries are short and de-identified. Copilot sends Bing a search query, not your files.
How a prompt flows
  1. You prompt Copilot — in Chat or inside an app
  2. Grounding — only content you may see, and/or the web
  3. Responsible AI checks — on the prompt and results
  4. LLM in the Microsoft Cloud — inside the service boundary
  5. Compliance & Purview — your policies apply to the response
  6. Answer back to you — with citations
Your part. Copilot drafts — you decide. Check figures, names and regulation references against the source before you share, and follow Bank Mandiri’s policies on data classification and AI use. Look for the shield next to your account.

Source Enterprise data protection in Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Chat — Microsoft Learn · Data, privacy and security for Microsoft Copilot — Microsoft Learn

Choosing your model in Chat

BasicPremium

You can choose which AI model answers your prompt. On Copilot Chat (Basic), leave it on Auto — Copilot picks the best model for the task — or choose Quick response or Think deeper. With Microsoft Copilot (Premium) you get more choices, including Anthropic Claude models. Some models may need to be enabled by your admin.

ChoiceUse it when
AutoMost of your work — Copilot picks the model for the task
Quick responseShort, simple questions where speed matters
Think deeperComplex analysis and multi-step reasoning — it takes longer

At the top of the chat, select the model selector (Auto) to see the available models. Your choice applies to the current chat.

3.5Copilot foundationsMicrosoftCopilot
03 · Copilot foundations

Bringing your files into Chat

BasicPremium

Three ways to put OneDrive, SharePoint and device files in front of Copilot.

Type / to reference

Type a forward slash in the prompt box to pick files already in OneDrive or SharePoint. Copilot suggests recent files — keep typing to filter.

Attach cloud files

Select the Attach cloud files icon to browse OneDrive and SharePoint in a pop-up — attach a single file or a whole folder.

Upload files

Select + in the prompt box to add files from your device. A copy is saved to your OneDrive.

Limits. Upload up to 20 files per conversation, 50 MB each. Without Microsoft Copilot (Premium) — or with Work IQ off — the / menu offers files only; people, meetings, emails and chats need Premium with Work IQ on.

BasicPremium

There’s one chat box with a single Work IQ toggle — flip it to control what Copilot grounds its answer in. The example prompts are written for Bank Mandiri work, in Bahasa Indonesia.

Copilot
ChatCowork

Flip the Work IQ switchOne chat, one toggle — not two separate chats.
Work IQ off Copilot Chat (Basic)Premium

Web-grounded chat

Copilot answers from the web and the model's training data, plus the files you hand it — none of your Microsoft 365 data. Every prompt starts with you finding, attaching or pasting the material first.

  • Open-web knowledge
  • Plus any files you attach — and, in Outlook and Teams, the content you have open
  • Available to Basic & Premium
Work IQ on Microsoft Copilot (Premium)

Work IQ–grounded chat

On by default. Copilot also reasons over your work across Microsoft 365 — emails, chats, meetings and files — trimmed to what you already have permission to see. The context is there before you type.

  • Everything web-grounded chat does
  • Your emails, chats, meetings and files
  • Permission-trimmed — nothing you can't already open

Tanpa Work IQ ·Operasional cabang
Ringkas /[SOP Pembukaan Rekening].docx menjadi 10 poin untuk briefing pagi frontliner, dengan bahasa yang mudah dipahami.
Tanpa Work IQ ·Finance
Bandingkan /[Realisasi Biaya Oktober].xlsx dengan /[Anggaran 2026].xlsx. Tampilkan 5 pos dengan deviasi terbesar dan pertanyaan yang perlu saya ajukan ke unit terkait.
Tanpa Work IQ ·Strategy · web
Cari tren terbaru adopsi pembayaran digital dan QRIS di Indonesia dari sumber publik tepercaya. Sertakan sumber dan buat ringkasan satu halaman.
Dengan Work IQ ·Persiapan rapat
Siapkan bahan rapat saya besok pagi: agenda dari undangan kalender, isu yang dibahas di Teams hari ini, dan email penting yang belum saya balas.
Dengan Work IQ ·Project lead
Rangkum perkembangan [nama proyek] minggu ini dari email, chat Teams, dan notulen rapat — keputusan apa yang sudah diambil, siapa PIC-nya, dan apa yang masih tertunda?
Dengan Work IQ ·Relationship manager
Dari rapat dan email dengan [nama nasabah atau unit] bulan ini, apa saja tindak lanjut yang saya janjikan dan mana yang belum selesai?

Notice the pattern. Each prompt starts with you supplying the material — attaching a file with /, or asking the web. Copilot is capable, but it starts from zero every time.

The prompt gets shorter, and the question gets bigger. You stop describing the material and ask about your actual work — your meetings, mail, chats and files are already in context.

Work IQ is part of Microsoft IQ — the intelligence platform that also brings Fabric IQ (Power BI and Fabric data), Foundry IQ and Web IQ. For the Enterprise Data Architecture team, Fabric IQ is the path to bring governed Power BI and Fabric data into Microsoft Copilot.

Use case — branch numbers in Excel, in plain language

Premium

Copilot explores your data, flags what is off target and builds the chart. Click through the demo on an illustrative branch report.

Compare with targetExcel › Copilot · Allow editing

Bandingkan realisasi dan target per cabang, tandai yang deviasinya lebih dari 5%, lalu buat grafik tren bulanan di sheet baru.

AnalyzeExcel › Copilot

Analisis tabel ini per wilayah dan per bulan: 3 temuan utama, wilayah dengan pergerakan terbesar, dan apa pendorongnya.

Explain a formulaExcel › Copilot · Chat only

Jelaskan rumus di kolom [F] langkah demi langkah, lalu sarankan rumus yang lebih sederhana dengan hasil yang sama.

Allow editing changes the workbook, Plan proposes steps first, Chat only answers in the pane. Use one header row and format the range as a table (Ctrl + T).

6.1AgentsMicrosoftCopilot
06 · Agents

Say it once as an agent — then just ask “Recap my week.”

The long prompt you would type every Friday becomes the agent's instructions. After that, three words return the same structured recap.

1Say it once — saved as the Weekly Recap agent's instructionsGoalSourceExpectations77 words

Recap my week. Based on my Teams chats and emails, list what has been done this week, grouped by topic. Output a table with Topic – Summary – Next action items. Then look at my calendar for next week and give me a table of the meetings: Topic, the action items I need to deliver for each meeting, and a priority level — whether I have to attend in person or can delegate it to someone else.

2

Then just ask “Recap my week.” — three words, and the agent returns the same two tables.A week later, the same three words — a different week, the same two tables. The structure lives in the agent's instructions.

6.2AgentsMicrosoftCopilot
06 · Agents

What is an agent? Should I make one?

An agent is a large language model with a harness around it — everything you configure so it does one job the same way, every time.

The harness is what turns a general model into your agent.
Your input“Recap my week.”A prompt, a file, a question
Your outputTwo tables, same structureAn answer, a file, an action
Agent= LLM + Harness
LLMThe engine — reads, reasons and writes
+
HarnessEverything you configure around the engineClick ① and ② to open it3 of 7 shown4 of 7 shownAll 7 shown
Instructions

What to do, and how to answer

Recap: two tables, same order
Knowledge

What it can read

Recap: my emails, Teams chats and meetings
Skills

Know-how it can reuse

Recap: Bank Mandiri rules to attend or delegate
Model choice

Which model, and how deeply it thinks

Auto · Quick · Think deeper
Tools & MCPs

Act in other systems

Copilot Studio
Topics

Guided conversation paths

Copilot Studio
Deployment channel

Where people use it

Copilot Studio

Should I make one?

  • Yes — you ask the same thing, the same way, again and again.Like “Recap my week” — the Weekly Recap agent.
  • Yes — your team needs one consistent answer from the same sources.For example, a policy and SOP procedures assistant.
  • Not yet — it's a one-off question.A good prompt is enough — see Prompting like a pro.
Where to build it
Agent BuilderIn Microsoft Copilot, no code: instructions, knowledge, skills and response mode.
Copilot StudioWhen it also needs tools and MCPs, topics or other channels.

The Weekly Recap agent — configured once in Agent Builder

This is the Configure tab behind “Recap my week.” Each highlighted field is part of the agent's harness — set once, then reused every Friday.

Copilot›Agents›Weekly RecapDescribeConfigureMock-up · illustrativeCreate
Weekly Recap12/30
Recaps my week from Teams and email, and lists next week's meetings to attend or delegate.
Think deeper

When I say “Recap my week”:

1. This week — from my Teams chats, meetings and emails since Monday, group the work by topic. Table: Topic · Summary · Next action items.

2. Next week — from my calendar, list the meetings. Table: Meeting · Topic · Action items to deliver · Priority — attend in person, or delegate and to whom.

Always these two tables, in this order. If something isn't found, write “Not found” — don't guess.

Kamu adalah asisten regulasi perbankan untuk karyawan Bank Mandiri.

1. Jawab dalam Bahasa Indonesia sederhana, sebagai langkah atau checklist.

2. Setiap poin: nomor peraturan, pasal dan tautan sumber.

4. Sebutkan status berlaku — diubah atau dicabut.

5. SOP internal Bank Mandiri: “Silakan konfirmasi ke unit Kepatuhan.” Jangan memberi nasihat hukum.
